when.test: (scope.companyIds != null and scope.companyIds.size() > 0) or (scope.stationIds != null and scope.stationIds.size() > 0)

mapper.select:
select
r.station_id as stationId, s.station_name as stationName, r.generation_kwh as generationKwh, r.charge_kwh as chargeKwh, r.discharge_kwh as dischargeKwh, r.consumption_kwh as consumptionKwh, r.grid_import_kwh as gridImportKwh, r.grid_export_kwh as gridExportKwh, r.revenue_amount as revenueAmount, r.feed_in_revenue as feedInRevenue, r.self_use_saving as selfUseSaving, r.storage_arbitrage_revenue as storageArbitrageRevenue, r.purchase_cost as purchaseCost, r.revenue_quality_reason as revenueQualityReason, r.equivalent_hours as equivalentHours, r.co2_reduction_kg as co2ReductionKg, r.standard_coal_kg as standardCoalKg, r.equivalent_trees as equivalentTrees,
r.device_id as deviceId, d.device_name as deviceName, d.device_type as deviceType, r.generation_kwh as generationKwh, r.charge_kwh as chargeKwh, r.charge_kwh as chargeEnergyKwh, r.discharge_kwh as dischargeKwh, r.discharge_kwh as dischargeEnergyKwh, r.runtime_hours as runtimeHours, r.runtime_hours as chargeDurationHours, r.runtime_hours as dischargeDurationHours, r.peak_power_kw as peakPowerKw, r.peak_power_kw as activePowerKw, r.avg_soc as soc, r.avg_soc as avgSoc, r.avg_soh as soh, r.avg_soh as avgSoh, r.alarm_count as alarmCount, concat(coalesce(r.alarm_count, 0), '条') as alarmSummary, d.status as runningState, d.status as batteryStatus, d.status as faultState,
r.tenant_id as tenantId, r.company_id as companyId, c.company_name as companyName, r.stat_time as statTime, r.data_quality as dataQuality, r.quality_reason as qualityReason
order by r.stat_time desc,
r.station_id r.device_id
asc
limit #{query.offset}, #{query.pageSize}

select count(1) as recordCount, min(r.stat_time) as minStatTime, max(r.stat_time) as maxStatTime, sum(case when r.data_quality is null or r.data_quality <> 'GOOD' then 1 else 0 end) as badQualityCount from
ems_report_station_hour r ems_report_station_month r ems_report_station_year r ems_report_station_day r
ems_report_device_hour r ems_report_device_month r ems_report_device_year r ems_report_device_day r
left join ems_device d on d.id = r.device_id and d.del_flag = '0'
where 1 = 1
and r.company_id = #{query.companyId}
and r.station_id = #{query.stationId}
and d.device_name like concat('%', #{query.deviceName}, '%')
and r.data_quality = #{query.dataQuality}
and r.device_type = 'INVERTER'
and r.device_type = 'PCS'
and r.device_type = 'ESS'
